tools.name: blueprint_backup_status
tools.title: 核對工作台備份
tools.description: Owner-only native V2.5+ maintenance status and the latest verified backup receipt. Reports local restore verification only, not off-host durability, deployment, or loaded chat tools. Do not expose backup contents or credentials. Sites requires its own supported backup adapter.

tools.name: blueprint_backup_create
tools.title: 建立完整私人備份
tools.description: Queue an owner-only native V2.5+ backup of the database, login settings and original attachments. Briefly pauses requests while creating and testing a consistent copy. Poll blueprint_backup_status for a new receipt; a queued request is not completion. Backups remain private on the host; download and verify a durable second copy before updates. Does not deploy or restore live data.
